screening.samplingFinding: All 120 unseen validation routes completed in isolated bounded headed Chromium children with zero parent hard timeouts. Strict machine checks accepted 104 pages. Original-resolution review then required at least eight query-relevant product roots and accepted 74 pages, for a 61.7% end-to-end yield without weakening capture or relevance gates.
screening.visualValidationFinding: Every accepted candidate-root screenshot was reviewed in fixed 4-by-3 page sheets and six-query site composites generated from immutable post-fix card captures. Thirty structurally valid pages were rejected for weak query coherence. The accepted pages preserve complete candidate screenshot coverage with zero evidence-identity mismatches.
